comment: Structured media slots consumed by src/components/DocMedia.astro.
Every documentation <DocMedia id="..." /> resolves through this file.
Session 21 (next capture session) walks items[].capture, drives the
studio at PUBLIC_APP_URL through Playwright, and writes public/media/
<id>.png (screenshot) or <id>.gif (gif). Until then every slot renders
the Stitch technical illustration declared as `fallback`.
